description: Tool to present a payment method on a simulated terminal reader for testing purposes. Use when testing payment flows, simulating card acceptance, or validating terminal reader integrations in test mode.

inputSchema.description: Request model for presenting a payment method on a terminal reader.

amount_tip.description: Simulated on-reader tip amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to represent $1.00).
amount_tip.title: Amount Tip

exp_month.description: Two-digit number representing the card's expiration month.
exp_month.title: Exp Month

exp_year.description: Two- or four-digit number representing the card's expiration year.
exp_year.title: Exp Year

reader_id.description: The unique identifier of the terminal reader to present the payment method on.
reader_id.title: Reader Id

type.description: Simulated payment type. Must be one of: 'card', 'card_present', or 'interac_present'.
type.title: Type

inputSchema.title: PresentPaymentMethodRequest

name: present_payment_method

PresentPaymentMethodResponse.description: Response model for the Terminal reader object.

action.description: The most recent action performed by this reader, if any.
action.title: Action

device_sw_version.description: The current software version running on the reader.
device_sw_version.title: Device Sw Version

id.description: Unique identifier for the reader object.
id.title: Id

ip_address.description: The IP address of the reader device.
ip_address.title: Ip Address

label.description: A human-readable label for the reader.
label.title: Label

last_seen_at.description: Timestamp of when the reader last connected to Stripe (Unix timestamp in seconds).
last_seen_at.title: Last Seen At

livemode.description: True if the reader is in live mode, false if in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

location.description: The ID of the Stripe Terminal location where this reader is registered.
location.title: Location

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs for storing additional information.
metadata.title: Metadata

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'terminal.reader'.
object.title: Object

serial_number.description: The serial number of the device.
serial_number.title: Serial Number

PresentPaymentMethodResponse.title: PresentPaymentMethodResponse

ReaderAction.description: Current action being performed on the reader.

failure_code.description: Machine-readable failure code if the action failed.
failure_code.title: Failure Code

failure_message.description: Human-readable failure message if the action failed.
failure_message.title: Failure Message

process_payment_intent.description: Details about the payment intent being processed, if applicable.
process_payment_intent.title: Process Payment Intent

type.description: The type of action being performed.
type.title: Type

ReaderAction.title: ReaderAction
